| description = Conjures a mystical portal that summons one of your allies to your side.  The target must be in your group to be summoned.  Consumes a pearl when cast.  Originally, this spell would clear agro on the target when summoned.  However, sometime near the end of Velious it was changed to not auto clear agro.  That said, after this time you can still clear agro by leashing mobs with the summon. Generates  Aggro as of 12/9/23
